verdict.rationale: Mercury's evidence pack shows a unified platform covering banking, virtual/physical cards, bill pay with AI-assisted invoice reading, AR invoicing, receipt matching, accounting sync (QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite), permissions/spend controls, and API/CLI/MCP access — directly consolidating spend, bill pay, and banking tools. Community testimonials corroborate real-world use as an all-in-one banking/spend platform (virtual cards, accounts, shared access) though one user notes an operational hiccup with mass card cancellation. Missing for 10: independent third-party comparison confirming full replacement of dedicated spend-management or bill-pay vendors, and clearer evidence on invoice/bill-pay volume limits or edge-case reliability beyond the single HN account.
